title: Which Egg Hides the Dragon?
youtube_description:
Can you guess which egg is hiding the dragon? Choose wisely — only ONE is the real deal! 🐉🔥 Watch until the end for the big reveal!

#Shorts #KidsVideo #GuessingGame #Dragon #Eggs #Kidify #FunForKids #BrainTeaser #GuessTheAnswer

scenes.narration: One of these eggs is hiding a DRAGON — but which one?!
You've got three choices — the red egg, the blue egg, or the golden egg!
Pick your egg! Three… two… one!
The RED egg cracks open and — it's just a rubber chicken. Nope!
The BLUE egg opens and — woah, it's a tiny hamster. So cute, but not a dragon!
The GOLDEN egg cracks and — ROOOAAR! It's a baby dragon! The golden egg wins!
Did you get it right? Level two is coming tomorrow — don't miss it!
